title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: email resolution answers customer emails without creating a case
summary: The briefing's roadmap facts, opt-in configuration and consumption-based licensing are supported. Minor corrections should complete two control paths, distinguish the billing pages' different overage rules, and remove checklist controls missing from the table.

Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/requirements-messages-management#overage-enforcement. Keep the scopes distinct and do not assert which enforcement governs email resolution.
